regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows a single dominant, crowded narrative — Oil & Gas Producers — with a high durability bar (0.71), high breadth (0.929), and trend-gate eligibility, while most other themes are ineligible (absolute-trend gate off). Rotation breadth is narrowing (6/16 eligible) and absorption is low (0.31). This is a one-narrative structure: leadership is concentrated, not rotating. Cross-sectional momentum itself has no forward edge here (track_record dir_accuracy 0.324), so any lean must rest on trend-gate discipline and my own judgement of narrative cohesion, not on rank.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners' score (1.015) translates into trend-gate eligibility on a durability-bar rise above roughly 0.4 with breadth expanding off 0.067 — that would mark a potential confirmed handoff from Oil & Gas toward precious metals; until then it is display-only and not a call.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers holds the trend-gate eligibility (the only validated risk-control leg), the highest durability bar (0.71), and unusually broad participation (breadth 0.929). In a one-narrative regime with low absorption (0.31), leadership that is both eligible and broad suggests the trend leg is intact. The crowding flag (crowded: true, crowding_z 1.19) is a size-down caution, not a fade; I would hold a direction rather than chase. Conviction is capped low because rank-IC is ~0 and track_record dir_accuracy is weak (0.324).
evidence: eligible: true with durability_bar 0.71 and hurst_tag 'mixed'
crowded: true, crowding_z 1.19 — size-down caution only
rotation.leader with margin 0.895 over Gold Miners
theses.dissent: Trend-gate eligibility has no mean-return edge, and Oil & Gas is crowded; a crowding unwind could hit it harder than the broad benchmark, and the detector's own direction accuracy is near coin-flip.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO drops below its own 20-day average with breadth falling under 0.6 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the only other clearly trend-eligible theme with a 'trend' hurst_tag, a solid durability bar (0.63), and non-crowded positioning (crowding_z 0.15). Within a narrowing-rotation regime, an eligible, uncrowded trend theme offers a de-risked alternative to the dominant crowded leader without trying to predict a handoff. Conviction is low because this is a diversification/size-discipline argument, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Banks are not receiving incremental attention (score only 0.635, rank 5) and a one-narrative market often starves secondary themes of flow regardless of trend eligibility.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO breaks below its own 50-day average while Oil & Gas breadth stays above 0.85 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
